title: Giving Back Together: Volunteering at Anna’s House
summary: See how Synopsys employees in Korea volunteer at Anna’s House, serving meals and giving back to people in the local community.
body_markdown:
##


This October, 15 Synopsys employees spent an afternoon volunteering at Anna’s House, helping with dinner service and connecting with members of the local community. The group came together voluntarily to lend a hand and give back.


The activity was part of Synopsys for Good, Synopsys’ global social impact program that gives employees opportunities to engage with their communities through volunteering and giving. In Korea, Synopsys employees have made volunteering at Anna’s House an annual tradition, returning each year to support the organization and the people it serves.


Meaning “a home where people embrace, share, and rely on one another,” Anna’s House is a social welfare organization that provides dinner six days a week, except Sundays, to people experiencing homelessness and others in vulnerable circumstances.


##


***Figure 1.** Kyungshin So, Kangbeom Lee, Sunkyum Kim, Naya Ha, and other Synopsys employees return to Anna’s House each year to continue giving back to the community.*


## A Special Start with “We Love You!”


Before getting to work, employees joined Father Ha Jong Kim and other volunteers in greeting those waiting for dinner with a cheerful “We love you!”


It was a simple but meaningful way to begin the afternoon. Making eye contact and exchanging greetings gave employees a chance to connect with the people visiting Anna’s House before dinner service began.


After sharing a moment of prayer and gratitude, everyone headed to their stations and got ready for the busy evening ahead.


##


***Figure 2.** Before beginning the volunteer activities, everyone came together for a moment of prayer.*


## As Dinner Service Began, Everyone Got Busy


There was plenty to do. Some employees served meals, while others washed dishes, guided guests to their seats, cleared tables, or handed out trays and utensils.


Once dinner service began, things quickly picked up. As more people arrived, everyone soon had their hands full.


It felt a little hectic at first, but as everyone settled into their roles and stepped in where help was needed, the team quickly found its rhythm. Before they knew it, the afternoon had flown by.


##


***Figure 3.** From serving meals to washing dishes, everyone pitched in wherever help was needed.*


## Even More Meaningful Together


It was a different setting from the usual workday, but everyone came together with the same goal: to lend a hand and support the local community.


One employee shared:


***“It was definitely busier than I expected, but once we got into the rhythm, the time just flew by. It was really rewarding to do something meaningful together with my colleagues.”***


##


***Figure 4.** As the volunteer activities came to a close, we shared words of thanks for the time we spent together.*


## Ending the Day with “Thank You”


After the meal service, everyone gathered once more for a moment of reflection and gratitude.


Just as the afternoon had begun with prayer, it ended in the same spirit. Father Kim personally thanked each employee for volunteering and giving their time, bringing the afternoon to a meaningful close.


Taking part in the meal service firsthand was a reminder of just how many helping hands it takes to bring a meal to the table. It also gave us an even greater appreciation for Father Kim and the volunteers who continue this work day after day.


From “We love you” to “Thank you,” it was an afternoon centered on connection, gratitude, and giving back.


Through Synopsys for Good, Synopsys will continue creating opportunities for employees to engage with their communities and make a meaningful difference together.
